description: A map layer of permitted industrial installations in Wales. The DataMapWales page says the Environmental Permitting Regulations implement the Integrated Pollution Prevention and Control Directive in England and Wales, that facilities covered are installations with significant releases to air, land or water or larger waste activities, and that the layer covers all process industry sites within the regime and some larger waste activities, with smaller waste operations in a separate dataset. The layer can be downloaded free as CSV, DXF, Excel, GeoJSON, GML, GeoPackage or zipped shapefile and used through WMS and WFS endpoints, with the attribution statement Contains Natural Resources Wales information, database right, all rights reserved, and a licence referred to on the page. Coverage is Wales, one point per permitted site. Caveats: the fields and update date are not shown on the page read. For simulation it places Welsh process industry sites for flood and pollution exposure studies. A related catalogue record is the Environment Agency register of installations for England.
